name: Hyundai Mobility Adventure
desc:
📢 Service End & Free Access Notice
Hyundai Mobility Adventure will end on Sep 4, 2025 (KST).
Enjoy all content for free from May 30, 2025 (KST).

[UPDATES] 
🌲 Check out the observatory and portal for Eco Forest! @Event Zone2 

🚗 N Concept Car Event for RN22e & N Vision 74 
- Test drive RN22e and N Vision 74 at Event Zone 3! 
- Experience dynamic driving with RN22e and the high performance of hydrogen-powered N Vision 74! 

🎮 Enjoy driving IONIQ 6! @Event Zone 1 
- Play three types of mini-games to experience the Streamlined design! 

🚗 Various Mini-games! @ Eco Forest 
– Rent an IONIQ 5 and Experience sustainable campaigns to get Eco-energy 
- Make vegan food using zero-waste ingredients! 
- Complete the Plogging to get upcycling items! 
- Rescue endangered animals in Jungle!
